integrity: Proof-based theorem; finite exact/numerical checker is supplementary; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed shapes strictly between zero and one; known lower endpoint; sample-mean moment estimate; KS and CvM only; ideal refitted conditional bootstrap quantiles. Not the paper's Fourier test or MLE calibration; earlier 2022 research warned about non-finite means and shape-one empirical size distortion. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A full-null bootstrap failure for moment-fitted Pareto goodness-of-fit tests
